WORK 2 -- migration epic 1386-5e7c-391d-4a74 (tearful-cleansable-gopher), decomposed + plan-reviewed

Six vertical slices, expand -> migrate -> contract:
  S1 2aa6 reviewer prompts + criteria routing + regenerated guide   depends_on 1f32
  S2 35bc heading-detection code + its test corpus                  (no deps)  PASS/certified
  S3 93d0 eval specs, eval solver, gold-set expectations             depends_on S1
  S4 44c7 author guide + user docs                                   depends_on S1,S2
  S5 0a8c store migration, 108 tickets bullets -> checkboxes         depends_on S2
  S6 5f4d residual sweep + CI guard                                  depends_on S1..S5
Epic PASS/certified. S1 and S3-S6 blocked by unclosed deps, so not reviewable by design; no --force used.

GATE FINDINGS THAT CHANGED THE PLANS:
1. S1 asserted grandfathering was already in effect -- 962 had not merged. Now a real depends_on merge-order edge.
2. plan_review_T2.md:10 is a FALSE POSITIVE: 'stated success criteria for a trial' = pilot metrics, not the heading. Removed from S1 scope with an AC asserting the phrase survives. Same class as O-RAN-SC. This corrected the map given to the operator.
3. S2 planned to DROP the epic clarity bonus. Measured against the real _clarity_score: fixture goes 6 -> 4, below the default threshold 5 (RED), and every real epic in the store drops by 2. Changed to REPOINT the bonus to Acceptance Criteria: score-neutral at 6, no padding, no live regression across the 108 tickets being migrated.

PROCESS DEFECTS WORTH FIXING (not filed as tickets, pending operator's call):
- composer.py create-time file-impact warning keys on ticket TYPE while P9 keys on HAS-CHILDREN, so an epic is told 'the file-impact-coverage gate will otherwise flag it' when P9 can never flag a container. Its own comment claims lockstep with the gate; it is not.
- Following that warning, I set file_impact on the EPIC to stop whole-HEAD attestation staleness. This is a WORKAROUND, not canonical: P9 treats containers as legitimately having no file_impact, and the author guide scopes the nudge to leaves. Safe (child-change detection runs via relation_snapshot, not file deps) but should be reverted if the operator wants the epic canonical.
- A ticket-creation loop shifted all six story descriptions by one position; caught because a review finding quoted the wrong ticket's text. Verify description-to-ticket mapping after bulk creation.
